narrative: On the board. A fresh sheet, a few lines only, the crown not yet a speech. The shut chronicle is still at the edge. On the board. One image written under the place. The sheet is not a quarter full. The pen is down. On the board. One line more, under the buckets. The rest of the sheet is empty.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the first sheet's opening and stopped inside it.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Two buckets
